startUrls.title: Workday career-site URLs
startUrls.description: One URL per company: the address of its Workday jobs page, e.g. https://nvidia.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/NVIDIAExternalCareerSite. A filtered search URL (with ?q= or location filters) keeps its filters.

searchText.title: Search keywords
searchText.description: Same as the search box on the career site, e.g. data engineer. Leave empty for all jobs.

titleKeywords.title: Title must contain (any)
titleKeywords.description: Keep jobs whose title contains any of these words (case-insensitive).

excludeTitleKeywords.title: Title must not contain
excludeTitleKeywords.description: Drop jobs whose title contains any of these, e.g. intern, senior.

locationKeywords.title: Location contains (any)
locationKeywords.description: Keep jobs where any location or the country contains one of these, e.g. Remote, Germany, CA.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within (days)
postedWithinDays.description: Only jobs posted in the last N days. Leave empty for all.

remoteOnly.title: Remote only
remoteOnly.description: Only jobs marked remote (by Workday's remote type, or 'Remote' in a location).

includeDetails.title: Include full details
includeDetails.description: Fetch each job's page for the description, all locations, country, ISO posted date, time type and pay range. Turn off for a fast title/location/link list.

maxJobs.title: Max jobs in total
maxJobs.description: 0 = no limit. You can also cap cost with the run's maximum cost setting.

splitLargeSites.title: Get past Workday's 2,000-job limit
splitLargeSites.description: Workday only pages through 2,000 jobs per search. When a site has more, split the search by category/location so every job is collected.

detailConcurrency.title: Parallel detail requests
detailConcurrency.description: Per site. Requests to each Workday host are also paced (about 8 per second).

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Not needed for most sites. Enable only if a site blocks requests.

maxRetries.title: Max retries per request
maxRetries.description: How many times to retry a failed request (network error, 429 or 5xx) before giving up on it.
